# Anthropic

The following Anthropic models are available in Amazon Bedrock:

Model | Description

Claude Fable 5.1 | Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic's frontier model for ambitious coding, long-horizon agents, and enterprise knowledge work. 
Claude Mythos 5.1 | Claude Mythos 5.1 is Anthropic's most capable model for cybersecurity defense and life sciences research, including threat intelligence, vulnerability discovery, red teaming, drug discovery, and biodefense screening. 
Claude Opus 5 | Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's most advanced Opus model, powering long-running agents while delivering improvements in coding and professional work. 
Claude Sonnet 5 | Claude Sonnet 5 is Anthropic's most capable Sonnet model yet, built for coding, agents, and professional work at scale. 
Claude Mythos 5 | Claude Mythos 5 is Anthropic's most capable model for cybersecurity and life sciences, including vulnerability discovery, drug design, and biodefense screening. 
Claude Fable 5 | Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's next-generation model for complex knowledge work and coding, capable of sustained autonomous operation across multi-day tasks.

Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Claude Sonnet 4.6 is a full upgrade of Anthropic's mid-tier model with improved coding, computer use, long-context reasoning, and agent planning with a 1M token context window. 
Claude Opus 4.6 | Claude Opus 4.6 is Anthropic's flagship model that plans more carefully, sustains agentic tasks longer, and operates reliably in massive codebases.

## Billing notes

The following billing behaviors apply specifically to Anthropic models on Amazon Bedrock:

- Refused requests (all Anthropic models onbedrock-mantle): When a request is refused by a content classifier before inference begins, no input or output tokens are billed. Mid-stream refusals — where the classifier fires after output has begun streaming — are billed for tokens consumed before the block. Both refusal types return stop_reason: "refusal" in the response.

Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's next-generation model for complex knowledge work and coding, capable of sustained autonomous operation across multi-day tasks. It plans across stages, delegates to sub-agents, and self-verifies its work.

- Max output tokens: 128K

- Reasoning: Supported (adaptive thinking is always on and cannot be disabled; effort level is configurable)

## Content Restrictions

Claude Fable 5 includes blocking classifiers for dual-use content in cybersecurity and biology. When a classifier blocks a request, the API returns a standard HTTP 200 response withstop_reason: "refusal" and a stop_details object containing the restriction category. Refusal rates on this model are materially higher than on previous Claude models.

Customers should handlestop_reason: "refusal" as a primary response path. Prompt-stage refusals (blocked before inference begins) are not billed. Mid-stream refusals (blocked after partial output) are billed for tokens generated before the block.

## Pricing

This model is a third-party model offered and billed through AWS Marketplace. Charges appear on your AWS bill and in AWS Cost Explorer under the model provider (not under Amazon Bedrock). For pricing, see the Amazon Bedrock Pricing page.

## Programmatic Access

Use the following model IDs and endpoint URLs to access this model programmatically. For more information about the available APIs and endpoints, see APIs supported and Endpoints supported.

Endpoint | Model ID | In-Region endpoint URL | Geo inference ID | Global inference ID

bedrock-mantle | anthropic.claude-fable-5 | https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws/anthropic/v1/messages | N/A | N/A

## Service Tiers

Amazon Bedrock offers multiple service tiers to match your workload requirements. Standard provides pay-per-token access with no commitment (set"service_tier": "default" or omit the field). Priority delivers the fastest response times for a price premium (set "service_tier": "priority"). Flex provides lower-cost access for flexible, non-time-sensitive workloads (set "service_tier": "flex"). Reserved provides dedicated throughput with a term commitment for predictable workloads; it is set at the account level rather than per request (contact your AWS account team to enable). For more information, see service tiers.

News – Introducing Claude Duet

03.11.2026

# Introducing Claude Duet

Anthropic has introduced Claude Duet, a new app where Claude works as a proactive AI agent. It flags what needs your attention, takes on tasks you hand over, and keeps going when you step away. But before it acts on your behalf, it checks with you first. Duet is built around Claude Opus 5.5 and launched in research preview in October 2026 for professionals and small business owners.

## What Can Claude Duet Do?

- Morning brief. You get a short rundown of important items across your connected apps.
- Background monitoring. Duet checks your connected accounts every few hours and messages you only when something needs attention.
- Delegated tasks. It takes on work from scheduling meetings to building dashboards, forecasts, prototypes, and web apps.
- One ongoing thread. You type or send voice messages in a single conversation.
- Its own virtual machine. Duet runs on a VM with its own browser, so your laptop or phone doesn’t have to stay on.
- Marketplace connectors. It plugs into connectors and plugins from the Claude Marketplace, including Gmail, Slack, QuickBooks, Stripe, and Shopify. For purchases, it uses a virtual card through Link, Stripe’s wallet, or Shop Pay at Shopify checkout.

## How Do the Approval Gates Work?

Duet reads, drafts, and prepares work on its own. Before it sends a message, makes a payment, signs a document, or deletes anything, though, it shows you the action and waits for your OK. Some actions stay off-limits even with approval, such as trading securities or moving money between accounts.

On top of that, a dedicated classifier rejects requests to share the strictest sensitive data, like credit card numbers and government IDs. And Duet shares health or personal finance details only when you explicitly tell it to.

## What’s in It for You

- Your Claude setup comes with you. Duet carries over the memory, skills, and connected apps from your Claude account, so there’s nothing to rebuild.
- Nothing goes out without your sign-off. Messages, payments, signatures, and deletions all wait for your approval, and you can disconnect any app Duet has access to.
- No separate subscription. Duet is included in Pro and Max plans and shares your plan’s usage limits with the rest of Claude. Background checks count toward those limits, and bigger tasks take more model turns and background work.
- Access starts with a waitlist. As of October 2026, the research preview opens by waitlist to US Pro and Max subscribers, on standalone iOS and Android apps and on claude.ai.
- Known limits to plan around. Anthropic notes Duet may misread a thread or misjudge urgency, handles personal errands like booking tickets less well than work tasks, and can’t yet show you its browser.

“An agent that keeps working while you’re away is only as useful as the boundaries you give it. We’d start with two or three connected apps and check whether Duet’s briefs and approval requests match what your team actually treats as urgent. Then add more.”

Andriana Zadorozhna GenAI Engineer, Data & AI Solutions Architect at Cloudfresh ⛅

## Where Cloudfresh Comes In

As an official member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, Cloudfresh is ready to support teams that want to put Claude Duet to work. We map out AI strategy and use cases, run Claude Training Sessions, and handle Claude Consumption & FinOps Optimization. You’ll know which tasks to hand to Duet, which apps to connect first, and how its background checks draw on your plan’s usage limits, so every message, payment, and signature still waits for the right person’s approval.

OpenAI.description: OpenAI 的使命是確保通用人工智慧造福全人類。目前每週有超過十億人使用 ChatGPT。我們希望打造的 AI ... 在 ChatGPT 中啟用這些能力，也擴大了模型能協助處理的任務範圍，讓 ChatGPT 不再只是聊天工具，而是逐步成為能真正自主執行任務的個人助理。
OpenAI.content:
載入中…

OpenAI 的使命是確保通用人工智慧造福全人類。目前每週有超過十億人使用 ChatGPT。我們希望打造的 AI，能協助他們應對日常生活中的實際挑戰，例如尋找托育服務、申辦政府服務、編列預算、準備上學、調整食譜、訂購食材、設計健身計畫等。

當人們尋求協助，希望讓生活更輕鬆時，所需的不只是建議或聊天回覆。要成為真正有幫助的個人助理，ChatGPT 應該能採取行動，切實把事情辦好。

為了持續衡量模型在日常任務上的表現，我們建立了一套任務評測，涵蓋使用者最希望 AI 和個人代理提供協助的領域。過去一年，我們運用這套評測，追蹤並推動模型在日常任務上的表現進步。

## 背景

為了找出人們最重視的任務，我們從兩項追蹤美國及國際民眾時間運用情況的大型研究著手：美國時間運用調查(在新視窗中開啟)和多國時間運用研究(在新視窗中開啟)。這些資料集共同提供了一份詳盡的日常生活任務清單，涵蓋不同人口群體在一天中不同時段及不同季節從事的活動。為了了解人們最看重 AI 在哪些方面的協助，我們在現有調查的基礎上，另行訪問了 3,995 位具人口代表性的受訪者。針對每項任務，我們提出多種問題，以找出一般民眾最希望個人助理提供協助的領域。最終選出的任務涵蓋人們最需要協助的重要領域，包括照護、健康、教育、家務管理、個人財務、購物，以及申辦政府服務。

## 個別任務範例

以下範例展示我們現有模型在日常生活實際工作流程中的表現。

### 搬家後報讀合適的幼兒園

比較我們新家附近的幼兒園，並篩選出最合適的幾間。

我已篩選出三間幼兒園，並整理好入學資訊。還有兩項偏好需要你決定。想看看候選名單嗎？

### 在洪水來臨前安排志工工作

幫我安排社區防洪志工團隊，協助四位需要防洪支援的鄰居。

我已擬好一份簡單的行動計畫，協助志工評估提到的地點，並為即將到來的惡劣天氣做好準備。

### 為我的家人尋找新家

幫我在盧澤恩郡找一間符合預算、附有獨立居住空間的房子，而且送孩子上學後，到公司的通勤時間要短。把房契加入我的購物車，讓我查看。

我找到一間符合你需求的房子。我已算好過戶稅，並將房契加入郡政府檔案系統的購物車，供你查看。

### 和遠方的奶奶一起看比賽

幫我設定一個簡單的方法，讓我和奶奶即使不在同一個地方，也能一起看比賽。

最簡單的觀賽方案已準備好，也有串流出問題時的備案。要我帶你和奶奶一步步設定嗎？

### 為剛確診糖尿病、正在適應生活的父親或母親準備餐點

制定實用的照護計畫和餐單，幫助我剛確診糖尿病的爸爸或媽媽適應生活。

第一週的計畫已準備好，包括餐單、提醒事項，以及要詢問照護團隊的問題。在分享給爸爸或媽媽之前，要不要一起確認一下？

我們最新的模型在許多 LifeVal 任務中都取得了很高的分數。

過去一年，我們透過訓練，讓模型在使用瀏覽器、操作電腦和運用連接器執行任務時，速度大幅提升、能力更強，也更符合使用者的意圖。在 ChatGPT 中啟用這些能力，也擴大了模型能協助處理的任務範圍，讓 ChatGPT 不再只是聊天工具，而是逐步成為能真正自主執行任務的個人助理。

## 這為何重要

為了確保 AGI 造福全人類，我們必須針對一般民眾生活中重要的事，衡量並推動模型進步。這表示我們不能只從學術角度評估模型的知識，還要實際衡量 AI 模型能在多大程度上協助人們做決定、處理日常事務，以及完成有意義的事。我們期盼 LifeVal 能成為邁向這個目標的一步。

## 作者

OpenAI

OpenAI.content:
# Do you know what GPT is?

GPT is a large language model developed by OpenAI with major financial backing from Microsoft, and is currently leading the market in terms of technology and capability.

AI technologies have been being developed at companies like Amazon, Google and Microsoft for some time. The first large language model, GPT-1, was released by OpenAI in 2018. It wasn't until the release of ChatGPT, which is powered by GPT, that the technology became widely known.

### Isn't it called ChatGPT?

Whilst sharing similar names ChatGPT and GPT are different. GPT stands for Generative Pretrained Transformer and refers to the large language model that underlies the ChatGPT frontend. This model accessed using an API.

This allows for developers to build their own applications leveraging the same capabilities of ChatGPT over the top of the GPT model. A great example of this is the SSW RulesGPT bot.

### Why is GPT cool?

<boxEmbed style="greybox" body={<> Why is GPT cool?

GPT is cool because it is a powerful artificial intelligence language model that can generate human-like text. It can be used for a variety of tasks, such as natural language processing, text generation, and question answering. It has the potential to revolutionize the way people interact with computers and make AI more accessible to the general public. </>} figurePrefix="none" figure="ChatGPT's response when asked "Why is GPT cool?"" />

### How does GPT work?

GPT models are trained on a huge amount of data (often refered to as parameters) that it can then use to predict what words should come next when given an input. For example, if the training data contains a weather report talking about beautiful clear blue skies, when you ask it what color the sky is it can call back to that data and respond blue.

GPT is trained on a huge amount of parameters.

- GPT-5: parameter count not publicly disclosed by OpenAI - the current generation and a significant step up from GPT-4.
- GPT-4: 1.76 trillion parameters.
- GPT-3: 175 billion parameters.
- GPT-2: 1.5 billion parameters.
- GPT-1: 117 million parameters.

### Strengths

- The model can respond to queries using natural language.
- The model can handle grammatical and spelling errors.
- Responses can come from the model very quickly - no need to access a database to retrieve data.

### Limitations

- The model is only as good as it's training data and has no knowledge of anything outside of this data.

Try it out in the playground

# OpenAI ChatGPT
import useBaseUrl from '@docusaurus/useBaseUrl';

Version: 1.4 Updated: April 30, 2026

The OpenAI API can be applied to virtually any task that involves understanding or generating natural language, code, or images. We offer a spectrum of models with different levels of power suitable for different tasks, as well as the ability to fine-tune your own custom models. These models can be used for everything from content generation to semantic search and classification.

Disclaimer: ChatGPT is an experimental research service provided by a third party, OpenAI, and use of it is subject to their terms and conditions. Output may be inaccurate or unreliable and may contain harmful instructions or biased content. Anything you submit may be used by OpenAI pursuant to their terms and conditions. You are using ChatGPT solely at your own risk. Sumo Logic will not be responsible for your use of ChatGPT.

## Actions

- Create Chat Completion (Enrichment) - Using the OpenAI Chat API, with gpt-3.5-turbo and gpt-4 you can do things like:
- Draft an email or other piece of writing
- Write Python code
- Answer questions about a set of documents
- Give your software a natural language interface
- Tutor in a range of subjects
- Translate languages

- Create Text Completion (Enrichment) - The completion endpoint can be used for a wide variety of tasks. It provides a simple but powerful interface to any of our models. You input some text as a prompt, and the model will generate a text completion that attempts to match whatever context or pattern you gave it. For example, if you give the API the prompt, "As Descartes said, I think, therefore", it will return the completion " I am" with high probability.
- List Models (Enrichment) - List and describe the various models available in the API. You can refer to the Models documentation to understand what models are available and the differences between them.

Chat Completion vs Text Completion:

Because gpt-3.5-turbo performs at a similar capability to text-davinci-003 but at 10% the price per token, we recommend gpt-3.5-turbo for most use cases. Both using two different API endpoints.

## OpenAI ChatGPT Configuration

Grab your API keys. Log into your OpenAI dashboard and click your profile icon at the top right. Go to View API Keys and click Create new secret key to generate your API secret key.

## Configure OpenAI ChatGPT in Automation Service and Cloud SOAR

How to open the integration's configuration dialog

- Access App Catalog and install the integration. (You can configure at installation, or after installation with the following steps.) 1. Go to the Integrations page. Classic UI. In the main Sumo Logic menu, select Automation and then select Integrations in the left nav bar. New UI. In the main Sumo Logic menu, select Automation > Integrations. You can also click the Go To... menu at the top of the screen and select Integrations. 1. Select the installed integration. 1. Hover over the resource name and click the Edit button that appears.

In the configuration dialog, enter information from the product you're integrating with. When done, click TEST to test the configuration, and click SAVE to save the configuration:

https://api.openai.com/

## Test Create Chat Completion action

Action Fields:

Ask Me Anything (Messages): Ask Me Anything (messages to generate chat completions) For Example: What are the steps for remediating a host in CrowdStrike?

Model: default: gpt-3.5-turbo, ID of the model to use. You can check the Model from the List models Action to see all of your available models. See the model endpoint compatibility at (https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/model-endpoint-compatibility) table for details on which models work with the Chat API.

Maximum Length (Tokens): The maximum number of tokens to generate. Requests can use up to 2,048 or 4,000 tokens shared between messages and completion. The exact limit varies by model. (One token is roughly 4 characters for normal English text)

Temperature: What sampling temperature to use (Controls Randomness), between 0 and 2. Higher values like "0.8" will make the output more random, while lower values like "0.2" will make it more focused and deterministic. We generally recommend altering this or "Top P" but not both.

Top P: A Number between 0 and 1.0. An alternative to sampling with temperature (Controls Diversity), called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with "Top P" probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass is considered. We generally recommend altering this or "Temperature" but not both.

Frequency Penalty: A Number between 0 and 2.0. How much to penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far. Decreases the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. Presence Penalty: A Number between 0 and 2.0. How much to penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far. Increases the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

OpenAI.title: OpenAI’s GPT Store is live: Create and Publish a custom Postgres GPT Expert
OpenAI.description: OpenAI’s GPT allows developers to create custom ChatGPT experiences to perform specific tasks or answer questions about a given topic. ... OpenAI’s GPT allows developers to create custom ChatGPTs that are experts in specific domains and enable additional capabilities like web browsing and DALL·E image generation.
OpenAI.content:
# OpenAI’s GPT Store is live: Create and Publish a custom Postgres GPT Expert

Do you have questions about PostgreSQL or Neon? We built a custom Neon and PostgreSQL OpenAI GPT expert to help you with your queries and projects.

OpenAI’s GPT allows developers to create custom ChatGPT experiences to perform specific tasks or answer questions about a given topic.

This article walks you through the steps to create your own custom GPT using Python and Postgres.

## What are GPTs?

Generative Pre-trained Transformers, commonly referred to as GPTs, are a group of machine learning models that provide human-like text interfaces that can answer questions in a conversational manner. OpenAI’s GPT allows developers to create custom ChatGPTs that are experts in specific domains and enable additional capabilities like web browsing and DALL·E image generation.

OpenAI has also introduced the GPT Store, a marketplace where users can explore and access various GPTs. Creators can feature their GPTs in this store and potentially earn money based on their usage by the community.

## How to create a GPT

Developers with a Plus or Enterprise subscription can create GPTs by interacting with the GPT Builder in ChatGPT, where they can add instructions, upload files for the knowledge base, and select capabilities such as web searching, image creation, or data analysis.

Here’s how to create a GPT:

Head to https://chat.openai.com/gpts/editor (or select your name and then “My GPTs”)In the “Configure” tab, enter the name, description and instructions.

Example of instructions we used for the Neon PostgreSQL Expert GPT: “Your role is to act as a PostgreSQL expert, specifically tailored for Neon’s database as a service. You will provide detailed, accurate information and guidance on PostgreSQL, focusing on its use within the Neon platform. This includes offering advice on best practices, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and the nuances of working with Neon’s database service. You should be thorough in your explanations, ensuring clarity and precision in your responses. In cases where exact details are required and not provided, you should ask for clarification to provide the most accurate and helpful advice possible. Your responses should reflect a deep understanding of PostgreSQL and its application in a cloud-based environment like Neon.”

When you’re ready to publish your GPT, select “Publish” and share it with others if you’d like.

You can find the instructions in the OpenAI Chatgpt Neon PostgreSQL Expert repo on GitHub.

## Enhance your GPT with Retrieval Augmented Generation

You can provide additional knowledge to your GPT by uploading text documents and a process named Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

RAG is a framework that enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) like GPT by allowing them to access facts from an external knowledge base. This helps overcome some of the limitations with LLMs, like accessing up-to-date and private information, or reducing hallucinations.

The advantage of GPTs is that you don’t need to fully understand RAG to expand your chatbot with additional knowledge. But if you’re interested in understanding what happens under the hood, typically, documents are uploaded, then the text is split into pieces and chunks, added to a vector database, and used for RAG. Each user’s request will trigger a semantic search in the database to find the knowledge related to the user’s question. To understand more about how semantic search works, check out the YC Matcher code on GitHub.

## RAG limitations with GPTs

Custom knowledge in GPTs is limited to 20 documents. Additionally, The text document formats that are currently supported to create GPTs are limited. For our example, we executed a script to crawl Neon’s documentation and generate markdown files.
import yaml

def read_markdown_file(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'r') as file:
        return file.read()

def process_items(items):
    combined_markdown = ''
    for item in items:
        title = item['title']
        slug = item.get('slug', '')
        full_path = f"../website/content/docs/{slug}.md" if slug else ''

        # Add the title as an H1 heading
        combined_markdown += f"# {title}\n\n"

        # Add content from the corresponding Markdown file, if a slug is provided
        if slug:
            markdown_content = read_markdown_file(full_path)
            combined_markdown += f"{markdown_content}\n\n"

        # Process any nested items recursively
        if 'items' in item:
            nested_content = process_items(item['items'])
            combined_markdown += nested_content

    return combined_markdown

def main():
    with open('../website/content/docs/sidebar.yaml', 'r') as file:
        sidebar = yaml.safe_load(file)

    combined_markdown = process_items(sidebar)

    with open('markdown/neon_documentation.md', 'w') as file:
        file.write(combined_markdown)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The above limitations make it difficult for applications with extensive knowledge bases and gigabytes of private data to be converted to GPTs. Another concern is related to data security. OpenAI operates as a black box, which makes it challenging to know what’s going on internally and how your data is accessed. This can be a blocker for users with sensitive data.

An alternative would be to create your own RAG app that uses open-source tools and models such as Mixtral 8x7B and pgvector. Learn more about AI concepts and how to use create a chatbot using pgvector and Next.js.

## Publishing to the GPT Store

One exciting aspect of building a GPT is that users can be paid based on engagement. To monetize your GPT, make sure to save it for Everyone and that you have a verified Builder Profile.

That’s it!

## Conclusion

GPTs and the GPT Store are a great way to create, monetize, and share your own custom ChatGPTs with the world. GPTs such as the Neon PostgreSQL Expert do not require developer knowledge and are designed to be easy to publish and enhance with a few clicks.

However, GPTs come with limitations and do not replace RAG apps for apps that require extensive private and custom datasets or a further customized experience at the moment.

What about you? Are you thinking of a GPT? Let us know your thoughts and if you built a GPT or a RAG app. Join us and share your projects with us on our Discord server.

Google.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon After Delays
Google.description: Alphabet's Google announced Gemini 4 Argon on September 30 ... Google no longer plans to release Gemini 3.5 Pro, which CEO Sundar Pichai originally said would arrive in June. The company overhauled its DeepMind AI lab, with founder Demis Hassabis stepping aside and several Gemini leaders leaving. In recent months...
Google.content:
Alphabet's Google announced Gemini 4 Argon on September 30, its first frontier AI model in more than seven months, as the company seeks to close a gap with OpenAI and Anthropic (Reuters, 2026).

The model is larger than Google's previous Pro line and is designed for complex workloads in software engineering, legal and financial work, and cybersecurity defense. A company spokesperson said Argon is comparable to OpenAI's Astra and Anthropic's Opus on key coding and cyber benchmarks. In a press release, Google reported better marks than both rivals on several industry benchmarks, though it remained behind on two of the four coding-related tests it included (Reuters, 2026).

Google is providing Argon to select cybersecurity partners and is participating in the Trump administration's voluntary pre-release model access process. It did not give a timeline for public release. The staged approach follows similar decisions by OpenAI and Anthropic, both of which have limited their most capable models to vetted partners due to security concerns (Reuters, 2026).

The model comes after months of internal upheaval. Google no longer plans to release Gemini 3.5 Pro, which CEO Sundar Pichai originally said would arrive in June. The company overhauled its DeepMind AI lab, with founder Demis Hassabis stepping aside and several Gemini leaders leaving. In recent months, Google has shifted its messaging from touting Gemini's cutting-edge capabilities to highlighting its cost advantage compared to competitors (Reuters, 2026).

Argon's release positions Google back in the frontier race, though the decision to withhold it from the public reflects the caution that now surrounds the most powerful AI systems. The company has not said when broader access will arrive.

Google.title: Facing a backlash to AI in schools, Google promises changes and draws one hard line in the sand
Google.description: ” said Kevin McKee, a research scientist at Google DeepMind ... One of those “helpful assistants,” Google’s Gemini, is available to many American students on school-issued laptops. But ... When Gemini is turned on, it will operate in Guided Learning mode, a feature launched last year that walks students through examples and questions rather than simply providing the answer.
Google.content:
# Google promises to stop doing students’ homework for them

Did you know search engines like Google are changing the way you see news? Keep Chalkbeat’s valuable education coverage at the top of your feeds by clicking here and checking the box next to our name.

It’s one of the biggest problems with AI and education: Students can present a chatbot with any question, from the volume of a cylinder to the causes of the Civil War, and get back fully formed answers that are mostly correct.

“By default, we train AI models to be helpful assistants that can do the work for the user,” said Kevin McKee, a research scientist at Google DeepMind, part of the tech giant’s AI for Education research team. “But in education, in contrast, students need to do the work themselves in order to learn. Good pedagogy requires guiding students through that productive struggle.”

One of those “helpful assistants,” Google’s Gemini, is available to many American students on school-issued laptops. But now the company is rolling out changes that it says will push students to do their own work and have Gemini serve as the sort of personalized tutor that many AI boosters hope the technology can be.

These include turning off Gemini as a default setting within Google Classroom. When Gemini is turned on, it will operate in Guided Learning mode, a feature launched last year that walks students through examples and questions rather than simply providing the answer. Guided Learning will also replace AI overviews when students use Google Search on school accounts.

The goal of the updates announced Tuesday is to give schools and teachers more control and promote student thinking and learning, company officials said.

Earlier this year, Google caught many school districts off guard by turning on Gemini for all students as the default setting, Education Week reported. Microsoft and OpenAI gear their educational platforms more toward teachers and limit student use, though students can easily use ChatGPT on personal devices.

But districts that don’t want any AI on school devices will bear a cost: They will have to forgo access to Google Search.

The changes come as large school districts such as New York and Los Angeles are severely restricting student AI use, and parents are demanding more control over how their children interact with technology at school. The Trump administration is considering requiring schools to adopt limits or allow parent opt-outs as a condition of receiving internet subsidies. Amid this backlash, Google continues to push AI as a powerful tool for student learning and expand its hold on classrooms.

Google is “excited” that the changes “will promote that productive struggle and help students really learn what they’re seeking to learn,” said Chris Phillips, Google’s vice president and general manager of education. “If a school is not comfortable with that and simply wants AI off, then they have the choice to not have search on at all.”

Activists for less screen time in schools said this catch represents “bullying.”

“The company’s hostile ultimatum is a desperate attempt to maintain its stranglehold on public education,” Lila Byock, founder of Schools Beyond Screens, said in a statement. “This kind of bullying has no place in our schools. Educational value — not shareholder value — must determine which products are used by students and regulators must intervene to prevent Big Tech from exploiting schoolchildren for profit.”

Phillips said AI is deeply integrated into Google Search and cannot just be turned off.

That integration has presented a huge challenge for student learning, said Eisha Buch, head of teaching and learning at Common Sense Media, an advocacy group.

“The likelihood of schools and students avoiding Google Search is really slim to none,” Buch said.

Instead, the company is presenting schools with a “choice that isn’t really a choice,” Buch said.

“Google could be putting its efforts into letting schools turn off AI Overviews and keep search,” she said. “Instead, it’s making schools take search away from kids. As a parent and a former teacher, I find it extremely sad that Google is forcing schools to choose between learning and keeping kids safe.”

Common Sense Media’s Youth AI Safety Institute says Google Search’s AI overviews and AI mode represent an “unacceptable risk” to students. Historically, Google has not allowed schools to disable AI overview, and turning off AI mode has required challenging technical workarounds.

The group rates Google Gemini K-12 as a “high risk” product. While it protects student data better than the consumer version and doesn’t pretend to be a friend, like some chatbots, Gemini often fails to provide age-appropriate responses and can easily be made to complete assignments, reviewers said.

Common Sense Media has not published a standalone review of Guided Learning. The original version of the feature launched last year shows promise, reviewers said as part of their overall review of Gemini K-12, but students could still get Guided Learning to do much of the work.

“It will complete homework assignments and essays, and the boundary between ‘helping’ and ‘doing the work’ is often unclear,” reviewers wrote.

Company officials said the version of Guided Learning that will be available through Google Classroom is more rigorous and has been developed with teacher input. Teachers can assign work through Guided Learning and review student chats to see how students approach problems and what questions they ask. Students will not be able to switch back into regular Gemini within Google Classroom.

The company will start testing the changes with a small group of U.S. schools this month and roll them out more broadly early in the new year.

Buch noted that regardless of updates Google makes within its Classroom platform, students will still encounter AI overviews on their personal devices and have easy access to other chatbots. And school district AI bans can only serve as a stop gap.

Students desperately need AI literacy, she said, and teachers need to assess student learning outside the confines of Chromebooks.

“We have to put pressure on companies to do better by kids and for kids and also make sure there is an urgency in helping students think critically and value their learning,” she said. “Ultimately that is what will lead to their own well-being.”

Editor’s note: This story has been updated with additional reaction.

Erica Meltzer is Chalkbeat’s national editor based in Colorado. Contact Erica at emeltzer@chalkbeat.org.

The Latest

While votes are still being counted in a handful of close races, unofficial results indicate that 11 candidates who were backed by groups supportive of charter schools and school choice are on track to be seated in January.

Students with emotional disabilities are more likely to drop out of school than graduate with a standard diploma. A small program in eight public schools partnering with NYU is trying a different approach.

The mill levy overrides would raise a total of $133 million for teacher pay raises, career and technical education classes, and building maintenance.

The five new members of the DPSCD board are Georgia Lemmons, Jameel Smith, LaMar Lemmons, Bessie Harris, and Aliya Moore, according to unofficial results. Read more about their priorities.

The new $18.4 million medical center offers a variety of services to students, including help with their dental, mental and physical health.

Three seats on the nine-member partisan board are up for election.

Google.content:
# Google发表Gemini 4 Carbon 17项跑分夺15冠 网络防御力称霸

撰文： 免费资源互联网社群

出版：更新：

Gemini 4 Carbon是Google DeepMind于2026年10月28日发表的前沿模型，在Google公布的17项跑分中拿下15项最高分，在资安防御的找漏洞、验证与修补三项基准测试取得最高成绩，也能处理连续数天的长时间工程任务。

Google在2026年10月28日发表Gemini 4 Carbon，距离10月中旬开放的Gemini 4 Argon只隔两周。官方称它是目前最强的模型，在Google公布的17项跑分中拿下15项最高分，Artificial Analysis智能指数v5.0以59分排名第1，并在找漏洞、验证漏洞可利用性与修补漏洞三项资安基准测试取得最高成绩。

# Google

@Google

Introducing **Gemini 4 Carbon**, our latest frontier model.

Carbon delivers improved performance across domains — ranking #1 on v5.0 of the @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index and sets a new state-of-the-art in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.

It’s rolling out starting this week to cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program, with expanded access coming soon

- Gemini 4 Carbon

Our next frontier model

和Argon刚发表时的做法相同，Carbon先提供给少数资安防御者，等调整好防护机制后，才会陆续开放给开发者、企业与一般用户。本文会整理Carbon的特色、跑分、价格与目前的使用条件。

## Gemini 4 Carbon是什么？

Gemini 4 Carbon是Google DeepMind的新一代前沿模型，由Google DeepMind资深副总裁暨Google首席AI架构师Koray Kavukcuoglu在官方博客发表。Google对它的定位有两个重点：资安能力达到业界最高水准，以及能处理更长时间、更困难的工程任务。

Carbon建立在Argon的基础上，Google表示研究人员与模型正在协同合作，加快能力提升的速度，同时强化安全防护。以Argon在10月中旬才刚开放来看，两代模型的间隔相当短，可以看出Google目前的更新节奏。

## Gemini 4 Carbon能力：长时间工程任务与网页开发

Carbon针对“长时程”任务设计，适合需要持续运作的代理式工作流程。Google内部团队的实测中，Carbon可以连续运作数天，遇到死胡同也能继续尝试，处理像是在大型程式码库与底层系统中找出并修补隐蔽错误这类多步骤的工程任务。

在能力提升的范围上，官方列出程式开发、代理任务、科学任务、全端网页开发与多模态理解，其中网页开发的产出品质与成品有改善，在WebDev Arena排行榜上提升89 Elo分，来到第4名（1768分）。

WebDev Arena的89 Elo分提升，官方未注明比较对象，其余能力的详细数字见下一段的跑分表。

## Gemini 4 Carbon跑分：和Argon、GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5比较

Google提供的跑分表把Carbon与Argon、GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Fable 5.1放在一起比较，共17项测试，测试方法请见官方评测方法说明。

【延伸阅读】年度十大AI工具排行榜出炉 ChatGPT蝉联榜首 新晋模型强势入围（点击连结看原文）

+5

## Carbon在17项测试中拿下15项最高分，与Argon相比则是17项全部领先。

差距最明显的是长上下文的GraphWalks（96.2%，次高为 Argon 的 84.2%）、资安的ExploitGym（54.8%，次高为 GPT-6 Astra 的 42.4%），以及知识工作的AutomationBench（53.9%，次高为Argon的51.3%，GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5分别为41.4%与42.5%）。Artificial Analysis智能指数59分，高于Claude Opus 5.5的58分与GPT-6 Astra的57分，比Argon的50分高出9分。

也有没赢的项目。FrontierSWE 2的最高分是GPT-6 Astra的65.5%，Claude Opus 5.5为62.3%，Carbon的61.2%排第3。电脑操作的OSWorld-2.1离线子集由Claude Opus 5.5以87.2%领先，Carbon的81.5%排第2。另外Vals Index v2.2（70.4%对70.2%）与SWE-sweep（9.6%对9.5%）的领先幅度不到1个百分点，差距很小。

但要注意的是跑分仅供参考。这份表格由Google自行公布，Carbon的资安成绩又是在没有防护机制下评测，一般用户之后拿到的版本也可能会有限制，再加上Carbon目前还没对一般用户开放，要等实际开放、有第三方测试与更多使用经验后，才知道日常使用的感受是否和跑分一致。

## Gemini 4 Carbon资安能力：找漏洞、验证、修补一次到位

资安是这次发表的核心，Google说Carbon在资安防御的完整流程，包含漏洞侦测、验证与修补，都达到最高水准。官方列出三项外部基准测试成绩，并注明是在没有防护机制的情况下评测：

官方另外提供几项实际使用回馈：

1. 在内部基准测试中，Carbon产生安全程式码的成功率比Argon提高2倍以上。
2. Chrome团队回报，在产生高品质修补程式方面，Carbon的表现比另一家实验室的大型前沿模型好10倍以上。
3. 云端资安平台Wiz观察到，Carbon在网页渗透测试基准中领先，这项能力是Wiz“Scan for Good”计划的核心。

要留意的是，上述基准测试是在没有防护机制下评测，一般用户之后拿到的版本会有资安限制，实际表现可能有差异，等开放后再观察比较妥当。

## Gemini 4 Carbon的安全与对齐改进

Carbon沿用Argon的多层安全架构，包含模型训练、即时滥用防御、提示词注入抵抗与思维链监控，在这个基础上，Google这次进一步强化模型在复杂或高压任务下的行为表现，官方列出的成果如下：

## Gemini 4 Carbon API价格多少？

Carbon上线时会沿用Argon的优惠价，之后恢复标准价：

Google没有公布优惠期持续多久，要采用的开发者要留意优惠期结束后输入与输出成本都会翻倍。目前API尚未开放，价格是官方先行公布的资讯。

## Gemini 4 Carbon 现在能用吗？香港呢？

Google说明采取审慎的开放方式，并且正在参与美国政府自愿性的发表前模型测试流程，目前只有部分资安防御者能用，香港用户与一般用户都还要等，开放状况整理如下：

官方的说法是，持续收集回馈并调整防护机制后，会让开发者、企业与一般用户透过Google的产品使用Carbon。如果想了解Fairwind计划的资格与申请对象，可以参考先前的Gemini 4 Argon介绍。

## 总结

Gemini 4 Carbon是Google目前最强的模型，在Google公布的17项跑分中拿下15项最高分，包含Artificial Analysis智能指数与三项资安基准测试，只有FrontierSWE 2与OSWorld-2.1分别由GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5领先。它也能处理长达数天的工程任务，同时在诚实度与抵抗提示词注入上有明显改进。价格方面与Argon相同，优惠价为每百万token输入2美元、输出10美元。

不过目前只有部分资安防御者能用，一般用户与开发者都还要等，Google也没有公布日期。如果你已经是Google AI Pro或Ultra订阅者，现阶段可以先使用Argon，等Carbon开放后再比较两者差异。

# Llama 4 Maverick 17B Instruct

## Meta — Llama 4 Maverick 17B Instruct

## Model Details

Llama 4 Maverick is Meta's 17-billion active parameter mixture-of-experts model with 128 experts, optimized for multimodal chat and instruction following. For more information about model development and performance, see the model/service card.

- Model launch date: Apr 05, 2025
- EOL no sooner than: Apr 05, 2026
- Legacy period: at least 6 months
- Model lifecycle policy: Model lifecycle (For Models Launched Prior to Sept 7 2026)
- Model EOL date: March 30, 2027
- End User License Agreements and Terms of Use: View
- Model lifecycle: Legacy
- Context window: 1M tokens
- Max output tokens: 8K
- Knowledge cutoff: Aug 2024

Input Modalities | Output Modalities | APIs supported | Endpoints supported 
---|---|---|---
Audio | Embedding | Responses | bedrock-runtime 
Image | Image | Chat Completions | bedrock-mantle 
Speech | Speech | Invoke 
Text | Text | Converse 
Video | Video 

###### Tip

Whenever possible, we recommend using thebedrock-runtime endpoint for new applications. See Inference endpoints supported by Amazon Bedrock for details.

## Capabilities and Features

Bedrock Features

Features supported usingbedrock-runtime endpoint

###### Note

Tool use and response streaming are supported separately, but not together. AConverseStream request that includes a toolConfig field fails with This model doesn't support tool use in streaming mode. Use the non-streaming Converse operation when you need tool use.

## Pricing

For pricing information, see the Amazon Bedrock Pricing page.

## Programmatic Access

Use the following model IDs and endpoint URLs to access this model programmatically. For more information about the available APIs and endpoints, see APIs supported and Endpoints supported.

Endpoint | Model ID | In-Region endpoint URL | Geo inference ID | Global inference ID 
---|---|---|---|---

For example, if region is us-east-1 (N. Virginia), then the bedrock-runtime endpoint URL will be "https://bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com" and for bedrock-mantle will be "https://bedrock-mantle.us-east-1.api.aws/v1".

## Service Tiers

Amazon Bedrock offers multiple service tiers to match your workload requirements. Standard provides pay-per-token access with no commitment (set"service_tier": "default" or omit the field). Priority delivers the fastest response times for a price premium (set "service_tier": "priority"). Flex provides lower-cost access for flexible, non-time-sensitive workloads (set "service_tier": "flex"). Reserved provides dedicated throughput with a term commitment for predictable workloads; it is set at the account level rather than per request (contact your AWS account team to enable). For more information, see service tiers.

Standard | Priority | Flex | Reserved 

## Regional Availability

Regional availability at a glance

Amazon Bedrock offers three inference options: In-Region keeps requests within a single Region for strict compliance, Geo Cross-Region routes across Regions within a geography (such as US, EU, and APAC) while respecting data residency, and Global Cross-Region routes anywhere worldwide when there are no residency constraints. Refer to the Regional availability by models page for more details.

## Quotas and Limits

Your AWS account has default quotas to maintain the performance of the service and to ensure appropriate usage of Amazon Bedrock. The default quotas assigned to an account might be updated depending on regional factors, payment history, fraudulent usage, and/or approval of a quota increase request. For more information, see Quotas for Amazon Bedrock documentation and see the limits for the model.

## Sample Code

Step 1 - AWS Account: If you have an AWS account already, skip this step. If you are new to AWS, sign up for an AWS account.

Step 2 - API key: Go to the Amazon Bedrock console and generate a long-term API key.

Step 3 - Get the SDK: To use this getting started guide, you must have Python already installed. Then install the relevant software depending on the APIs you are using.
pip install boto3

Step 4 - Set environment variables: Configure your environment to use the API key for authentication.
AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK="<provide your Bedrock API key>"

Step 5 - Run your first inference request: Save the file asbedrock-first-request.py

Invoke API
import json
import boto3

client = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime', region_name='us-east-1')
response = client.invoke_model(
    modelId='meta.llama4-maverick-17b-instruct-v1:0',
    body=json.dumps({
            'messages': [{ 'role': 'user', 'content': 'Can you explain the features of Amazon Bedrock?'}],
            'max_tokens': 1024
    })
)
print(json.loads(response['body'].read()))

Converse API

client = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime', region_name='us-east-1')

    ]
)
print(response)

Meta.content:
Call Meta’s Muse and Llama models from Guild agents through the Meta API or OpenRouter, with model policies on every workspace and agent.

Integrations · Meta

Guild agents call Meta’s Muse and Llama models through task.llm, with no API key in agent code. Guild holds the credential server-side, checks your model policies on every call, and attributes spend to the workspace, agent, and user that made it.

The Meta API serves Muse models and speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions format. Guild reaches it through its unified LLM proxy. OpenRouter serves both families: Muse under meta/ and Llama under meta-llama/.

In Access & setup > Models & providers, click Add API key and choose a provider that serves Muse and Llama models. Check Meta under Models. On a managed account, you can skip this while Guild holds a managed Meta key.

2

Write a model policy

Bind the credential’s Meta access to the account, a workspace, or an agent, and list the models it may call, such as muse-*.

3

Call it from task.llm

Name "meta" in llmPreferences, or leave preferences out and let your policies choose. Guild resolves the credential at runtime.

Every Muse and Llama call goes through your policies

Agents never hold the key. Guild stores the credential server-side and shows only a masked value, so you can rotate it without touching agent code or the model policies bound to it. Policies are an allowlist: a workspace, agent, or installed agent can call a Muse and Llama model only if a rule allows it. Set a daily token limit to cap spend, and see each call by workspace, agent, and user in Usage.A raw API key in an agent’s environment reaches every model the key can. A policy reaches only the models you name.

Guild prices and recognizes these Meta model IDs. A policy or preference can also name any other model your credential can reach. Third-party providers route more models than this list, and their catalogs change; see each provider’s page for what it serves.

On a managed account, agents can use Meta models without a credential, as long as Guild holds a managed key for Meta. To use your own Meta account instead, add a credential. Adding your first credential switches the whole account to bring your own key (BYOK).

1

Open Models & providers

Click Access & setup in the left nav, then Models & providers. In an organization, only admins can open it.

2

Add a credential

Click Add API key and choose an inference provider from the table above.

3

Enter the provider's secret

Give the credential a Name and paste your provider’s API key. AWS Bedrock asks for an IAM role and region instead.

4

Choose Meta

Under Models, check Meta. Keep muse-spark-1.1 as its default model or enter another from the list above. Then click Add Key.

To control which workspaces and agents can use Meta models, add a model policy for the credential. For example, --models "muse-*" limits a policy to matching models:

The first entry asks for muse-spark-1.2. The second falls back to the default model of the matching policy. Preferences are strict: if no credential or policy allows any of them, the call fails rather than using another publisher. See LLM preferences.

# Meta Llama models

This section describes the request parameters and response fields for Meta Llama models. Use this information to make inference calls to Meta Llama models with the InvokeModel and InvokeModelWithResponseStream (streaming) operations. This section also includes Python code examples that shows how to call Meta Llama models. To use a model in an inference operation, you need the model ID for the model. To get the model ID, see Supported foundation models in Amazon Bedrock. Some models also work with the Converse API. To check if a specific Meta Llama model supports a feature, see models at a glance. For more code examples, see Code examples for Amazon Bedrock using AWS SDKs.

Foundation models in Amazon Bedrock support input and output modalities, which vary from model to model. To check the modalities that Meta Llama models support, see Supported foundation models in Amazon Bedrock. To check which Amazon Bedrock features the Meta Llama models support, see Supported foundation models in Amazon Bedrock. To check which AWS Regions that Meta Llama models are available in, see Supported foundation models in Amazon Bedrock.

When you make inference calls with Meta Llama models, you include a prompt for the model. For general information about creating prompts for the models that Amazon Bedrock supports, see Prompt engineering concepts. For Meta Llama specific prompt information, see the Meta Llama prompt engineering guide.

###### Note

Llama 3.2 11B Instruct, Llama 3.2 90B Instruct, Llama 4 Scout 17B Instruct, and Llama 4 Maverick 17B Instruct models use geofencing. Access to these models is restricted based on the country associated with your AWS account and the country associated with the request's source IP address. For information about supported countries and territories, see Serverless Third-Party Model License Agreements.

This section provides information for using the following models from Meta.

- Llama 3 Instruct
- Llama 3.1 Instruct
- Llama 3.2 Instruct
- Llama 3.3 Instruct
- Llama 4 Instruct

###### Topics

## Request and response

The request body is passed in thebody field of a request to InvokeModel or InvokeModelWithResponseStream.

###### Note

Response streaming works with these models. Tool use within a streaming request does not: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Llama 3.1 70B Instruct, Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, Llama 4 Scout 17B Instruct, and Llama 4 Maverick 17B Instruct accept atoolConfig field only on the non-streaming Converse operation. Sending toolConfig to ConverseStream fails with This model doesn't support tool use in streaming mode.

Request

The Llama 3 Instruct, Llama 3.1 Instruct, Llama 3.2 Instruct, and Llama 4 Instruct models have the following inference parameters:
{
    "prompt": string,
    "temperature": float,
    "top_p": float,
    "max_gen_len": int
}

NOTE: Llama 3.2 and later models addsimages to the request structure, which is a list of strings. Example: images: Optional[List[str]]

The following are required parameters:

prompt – (Required) The prompt that you want to pass to the model. For optimal results, format the conversation with the following template.
<|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>

What can you help me with?<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

Example template with system prompt

The following is an example prompt that includes a system prompt.
<|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>

You are a helpful AI assistant for travel tips and recommendations<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>

What can you help me with?<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

Multi-turn conversation example

The following is an example prompt of a multi-turn conversation.
<|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>

What is the capital of France?<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

The capital of France is Paris!<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>

What is the weather like in Paris?<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

Example template with system prompt

For more information, see Meta Llama 3.

The following are optional parameters:

temperature – Use a lower value to decrease randomness in the response.

Default | Minimum | Maximum 
---|---|---
0.5 | 0 | 1 
top_p – Use a lower value to ignore less probable options. Set to 1.0 to disable. 

Default | Minimum | Maximum 
---|---|---
0.9 | 0 | 1 
max_gen_len – Specify the maximum number of tokens to use in the generated response. The model truncates the response after the generated text exceeds max_gen_len. 

Default | Minimum | Maximum 
---|---|---
512 | 1 | 2048 

Response

The Llama 3 Instruct models return the following fields for a text completion inference call.
{
    "generation": "\n\n<response>",
    "prompt_token_count": int,
    "generation_token_count": int,
    "stop_reason" : string
}

More information about each field is provided below.

- generation – The generated text.
- prompt_token_count – The number of tokens in the prompt.
- generation_token_count – The number of tokens in the generated text.
- stop_reason – The reason why the response stopped generating text. Possible values are: stop – The model has finished generating text for the input prompt. length – The length of the tokens for the generated text exceeds the value ofmax_gen_len in the call to InvokeModel (InvokeModelWithResponseStream, if you are streaming output). The response is truncated to max_gen_len tokens. Consider increasing the value of max_gen_len and trying again.

## Example code

This example shows how to call the Llama 3 Instruct model.
# Use the native inference API to send a text message to Meta Llama 3.

import boto3
import json

from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

# Create a Bedrock Runtime client in the AWS Region of your choice.
client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name="us-west-2")

# Set the model ID, e.g., Llama 3 70b Instruct.
model_id = "meta.llama3-70b-instruct-v1:0"

# Define the prompt for the model.
prompt = "Describe the purpose of a 'hello world' program in one line."

# Embed the prompt in Llama 3's instruction format.
formatted_prompt = f"""
<|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>
{prompt}
<|eot_id|>
<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>
"""

# Format the request payload using the model's native structure.
native_request = {
    "prompt": formatted_prompt,
    "max_gen_len": 512,
    "temperature": 0.5,
}

# Convert the native request to JSON.
request = json.dumps(native_request)

try:
    # Invoke the model with the request.
    response = client.invoke_model(modelId=model_id, body=request)

except (ClientError, Exception) as e:
    print(f"ERROR: Can't invoke '{model_id}'. Reason: {e}")
    exit(1)

# Decode the response body.
model_response = json.loads(response["body"].read())

# Extract and print the response text.
response_text = model_response["generation"]
print(response_text)

This example shows how to control the generation length using Llama 3 Instruct models. For detailed responses or summaries, adjustmax_gen_len and include specific instructions in your prompt.

DeepSeek.content:
# AI agents being given greater autonomy

#### By CHENG YU | China Daily

#### Updated: 2026-11-03 09:32

Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek has unveiled a new architecture aimed at making AI agents more autonomous, marking the latest push by China's model developers to move beyond chatbots toward systems capable of independently carrying out complex tasks.

DeepSeek's Harness team said in an article published on Saturday that its experimental "super-agent" architecture is designed to allow AI to continuously monitor information, manage multiple tasks in parallel and take action with less human supervision.

The development points to a broader shift in China's fast-moving AI industry, where competition is increasingly moving beyond model size and benchmark scores toward agents that can plan, execute and complete real-world work.

As AI models become better at handling individual tasks, Deep-Seek said the bottleneck is increasingly human attention: users still have to switch between different conversations, keep track of their progress and provide instructions.

The super-agent approach is intended to move much of that coordination into the AI system itself, allowing people to focus more on higher-level decisions and reviewing results rather than overseeing each step of a task. Deep-Seek stressed that the architecture remains an engineering exploration rather than a feature available in its existing products.

DeepSeek said an internal version of the system is already operating continuously. When employees flag a software problem in a group chat, for example, the AI can identify the potential defect even without being directly addressed, attempt to reproduce the problem in the background and search for a fix.

The push reflects a growing focus across the AI industry on so-called agentic AI — systems designed not only to generate text or answer questions, but also to make plans, use tools and carry out multi-step tasks.

Chinese developers have accelerated model releases in recent weeks. The flurry of releases suggests China's AI race is entering a new phase. Rather than simply building models that are bigger or score higher on tests, developers are increasingly competing over whether AI can reliably turn intelligence into action.

Moonshot AI released last month Kimi K3.1 Pro, the first model in its new K3.1 series. The company said the model, its most capable in the roughly 3-trillion-parameter class, offers substantial improvements in coding, 3D creation, financial research and other long-horizon agent tasks, while supporting a context window of 1 million tokens.

MiniMax launched its M3.1 Flash model mid-October, saying it had strengthened performance in agentic tasks, coding and computer use while delivering online inference speeds nearly three times faster than its predecessor and cutting the overall cost of agent tasks by 70 percent.

DeepSeek itself updated its V4.1 Flash model on Oct 17. DeepSeek said the update improved performance while allowing tasks to be completed faster and with shorter outputs.

Wei Kai, head of the AI research institute at the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, said in a separate interview that agents represent an engineering enhancement built on top of large language models that can significantly extend their capabilities.

But challenges remain. "Agents still need improvement in reliability, contextual memory and long-horizon tasks, and there is still some distance to go before large-scale adoption," Wei said.

DeepSeek.content:
乌镇奏响开源开放协奏曲

中国新闻网

2026-11-04 13:33北京中新网信息科技有限公司官方账号

关注

“为什么要开源？答案非常简单，为了AGI(通用人工智能)更快到来。”

11月3日，深度求索(DeepSeek)研究工程师高熙在2026世界互联网大会乌镇峰会“人工智能乌镇对话”中，回应了DeepSeek开源逻辑。

AGI被视为人工智能发展的终极目标之一，代表在任何认知任务上达到或超越人类水平的人工智能系统。“如果说AGI本来要10年才到来，我会希望在一年后到，如果AGI本来是一年到来，那我希望明天就到。”高熙这番话，道出了希望通过开源加快AI发展的初衷。

DeepSeek可谓是开源的急先锋。近期，其宣布将内部推理框架DeepInfer全面开源。开源的选择，也成就了DeepSeek。全球AI模型聚合平台OpenRouter数据显示，10月19日到25日，DeepSeek登顶全球第一。

德国明斯特大学教授Bernd Holznagel对三里河表示，现在硅谷许多公司及德国40%-50%的中小企业都在使用中国的开源大模型。“我也用过DeepSeek，很好用。”

开源是中国大模型的鲜明标志。阿里巴巴集团联合创始人、董事会主席蔡崇信表示，中国同仁们在AI发展上不约而同地选择开源，是来自中国创新的重要精神内核。AI只有开源才能普及，只有普及才能创造可持续、普惠的智能时代。

在阿里巴巴ATH事业群千问大语言模型项目负责人刘大一恒看来，开源改变了AI创新的范式，使核心技术不再仅掌握在少数企业手中，而是让全球开发者和生态共同参与创新。而且，开源模型的存在将模型性价比拉升至较高区间，避免了闭源模型可能出现的价格垄断，降低了大众使用门槛。

但不可否认的是，开源模型同样具有风险，如何在开源开放中维护安全可信、在共建共享中缩小发展差距，成为全球重大挑战。

安全不是某一家公司、某一个国家独自扛下的担子。“安全这件事不能听天由命，不能只靠少数顶尖学者或者一小群人，必须建立一套成型的机制。”国际人工智能治理协会主席约翰·希金斯表示，在开源体系下，安全责任由大家共同分担，因此共同体建设尤为关键。

今年乌镇峰会的主题，正是“开源开放 共建共享——携手构建网络空间命运共同体”。

呼应全球关切，峰会期间发布的《携手构建全球开放人工智能行动倡议》，围绕共同推进开放和发展、共同维护安全和可信、共同参与对话和治理、共同坚持互利和包容四个方面，提出18条具体行动倡议。

它传递的信号很明确，AI 不是单打独斗的赛场，需要共商共建共享的治理思路，一起搭建公平可信、可持续的智能生态。

说到底，乌镇这场关于开源的讨论，回答的不只是一家企业的技术路线，更是AI 时代我们想走一条什么样的路。

AI 这条路，有两种走法，一种是攥紧技术、关起门独享红利；另一种是打开大门，汇聚全世界的智慧一起往前走。开源，选的是后者。

现实已表明，垒起“小院高墙”、构筑“数字铁幕”的封闭生态，难以独立支撑全球公平普惠发展。尽管开源的前路还有不少难题，但已是人心所向、大势所趋。

For example, if region is us-east-1 (N. Virginia), then the bedrock-runtime endpoint URL will be "https://bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com" and for bedrock-mantle will be "https://bedrock-mantle.us-east-1.api.aws/v1".

## Service Tiers

Amazon Bedrock offers multiple service tiers to match your workload requirements. Standard provides pay-per-token access with no commitment (set"service_tier": "default" or omit the field). Priority delivers the fastest response times for a price premium (set "service_tier": "priority"). Flex provides lower-cost access for flexible, non-time-sensitive workloads (set "service_tier": "flex"). Reserved provides dedicated throughput with a term commitment for predictable workloads; it is set at the account level rather than per request (contact your AWS account team to enable). For more information, see service tiers.

## Regional Availability

Amazon Bedrock offers three inference options: In-Region keeps requests within a single Region for strict compliance, Geo Cross-Region routes across Regions within a geography (such as US, EU, and APAC) while respecting data residency, and Global Cross-Region routes anywhere worldwide when there are no residency constraints. For more information, see Quotas for Amazon Bedrock documentation and see the limits for the model.

## Sample Code

Step 1 - AWS Account: If you have an AWS account already, skip this step. If you are new to AWS, sign up for an AWS account.

Step 2 - API key: Go to the Amazon Bedrock console and generate a long-term API key.

Step 3 - Get the SDK: To use this getting started guide, you must have Python already installed. Then install the relevant software depending on the APIs you are using.

Chat Completions API
pip install boto3 openai

Invoke/Converse API
pip install boto3

Step 4 - Set environment variables: Configure your environment to use the API key for authentication.

Chat Completions API
OPENAI_API_KEY="<provide your Bedrock API key>"
OPENAI_BASE_URL="https://bedrock-runtime.<your-region>.amazonaws.com/openai/v1"

AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK="<provide your Bedrock API key>"

Step 5 - Run your first inference request: Save the file asbedrock-first-request.py

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek.v3.1",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Can you explain the features of Amazon Bedrock?"}]
    )
print(response)

Invoke API
import json
import boto3

client = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime', region_name='us-east-1')
response = client.invoke_model(
    modelId='deepseek.v3-v1:0',
    body=json.dumps({
            'messages': [{ 'role': 'user', 'content': 'Can you explain the features of Amazon Bedrock?'}],
            'max_tokens': 1024
    })
)
print(json.loads(response['body'].read()))

Converse API
import boto3

client = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime', region_name='us-east-1')
response = client.converse(
    modelId='deepseek.v3-v1:0',
    messages=[
        {
            'role': 'user',
            'content': [{'text': 'Can you explain the features of Amazon Bedrock?'}]
        }
    ]
)
print(response)

DeepSeek.content:
## 该区域包含我要投稿

# DeepSeek发布创作者模式，下一代大模型计划基于华为昇腾芯片预训练

澎湃新闻记者范佳来 2026-11-03 20:34:19

2026-11-03 20:34:19 作者: 范佳来 来源: 澎湃新闻记者范佳来

## 该区域包含正文

“你的Harness，由你定义。”（Your Harness. You Define It）在发布智能体更新后，DeepSeek再次更新Creator Mode（创作者模式）。

11月2日，澎湃新闻记者获悉，DeepSeek Harness发布Creator Mode（创作者模式）演示视频，集中展示通过对话创建插件的能力，并公开七组演示的中英文提示词。

据DeepSeek在推送中介绍：“来认识DeepSeek Harness中的‘创造模式’，把想法转化为你能直接使用的插件：可以是设计工作台、沙盒游戏，或是一个3D大模型可视化工具，你会创造出什么？”

所谓Harness，是指围绕大语言模型构建的一套软件支撑框架，旨在帮助AI Agent管理和执行更加复杂的任务。简单来说，它可以被理解为让一个大模型真正成为Agent所需要的整套运行系统。

具体而言，此次展示的Creator Mode，是让用户通过对话创建自己的工具和界面。用户切换到Creator mode，在输入框里描述需求后就能打开插件，不同颜色的便签排列在画面里。输入内容、选择颜色，就能把想法添加到墙上，生成的插件可以从侧栏或会话中打开，以独立面板呈现。这也体现Harness“一切皆插件”的设计：通过安装或创建插件，扩展工具、技能和界面。

通俗来说，此次更新的创造模式，指的是用户口头描述一个需求，系统就能把它写成一个即插即用、可在桌面端运行的插件，典型例子正是文中提到的设计工作台、沙盒游戏、3D LLM可视化工具等。

此次展示进一步扩展DeepSeek Harness的使用场景：用户可通过对话创建插件，将设计、剪辑、阅读等工具接入日常工作，并按需调整应用界面。

此前澎湃新闻记者确认到，DeepSeek下一代大模型DeepSeek V5计划基于华为昇腾芯片进行预训练。此前华为昇腾芯片主要用于DeepSeek大模型的推理任务，V5将是其首款原生依托昇腾950开展训练的大模型。华为昇腾950系列分为950PR与950DT两款芯片，均基于第三代达芬奇架构，主要面向大模型的训练与推理场景。

10月31日，DeepSeekHarness团队在官方公众号发表技术文章《Super-agent设计探索：迈向更自主的Agent系统》。

DeepSeek表示，模型能力提升催生了新的应用形态，个人助手（Personal Agent）开始集中涌现。它们直接接入日常的消息、日程、邮件与工作平台，持续观察信息流并协助处理事务。这种持续在线、事件驱动的工作模式并不局限于个人场景，个人助手只是其中一类应用；在软件开发等商业场景中，它同样很有价值。

然而，现有主流Agent设计还难以在多任务和团队协作的规模上支撑这一模式，多任务上限取决于人的注意力。

Agent的工作模式仍然以单一Session为基本单位，不同Session之间彼此独立。当用户并行推进多项工作时，必须手动切换并记住各个Session的上下文，而据团队观察，一个人通常只能同时跟进3到5个活跃Session。在这种设计下，单任务的上限取决于模型能力，多任务的上限取决于人的注意力。

DeepSeek团队通过双层架构、事件驱动、异步多信道交互、存算分离与外部Watchdog，系统在底层接管了繁琐的会话管理与上下文同步，使人类得以从具体的执行细节进一步上移到更高层的决策与验收。DeepSeek把这种Agent形态及其系统架构称为Super-agent。

作者：范佳来

# Qwen3.8抢先体验！大家要心理准备了，最新版发布并开源了？

2026-11-05 6

举报

简介： Qwen3.8系列已于2026年8月起全线开源，涵盖Max（2.4T）、27B（Apache 2.0）、Flash及Flash-Next四版本，支持本地部署与商用（部分需授权）。Qwen4仍在训练，尚未发布。

### Qwen3.8全线开源落地：旗舰可下载、商用有门槛，Qwen4仍在训练中

【本报讯】 针对近期开发者社区热议的“Qwen3.8抢先体验”话题，经核验阿里云官方公告及2026云栖大会披露信息确认：

开源活动（链接入口）：https://www.aliyun.com/product/tongyi

Qwen3.8系列并非即将发布的新品，而是已于2026年8月正式启动开源，并于10月下旬完成全系列开放的现役模型。与此同时，下一代Qwen4目前仍处于训练阶段，尚未正式发布。

本轮开源标志着国产大模型进入“旗舰权重可下载、本地部署可落地、商用授权需合规”的新阶段。

#### 一、 发布时间线澄清：已全面开放，非“即将发布”

检索结果显示，Qwen3.8系列的发布节奏清晰明确：

- 2026年7月19日：Qwen3.8-Max预览版率先上线Token计划及Qcoder平台。
- 2026年8月3日：Qwen3.8-Max正式版发布，API上线千问AI平台；同周开源模型权重。
- 2026年8月27日：Qwen3.8-Flash及Flash-Next开源，Hugging Face与ModelScope同步上线。
- 2026年9月2日：Qwen3.8-Max更新至0902版本，编程与办公能力显著增强。
- 2026年10月下旬：从2.4T旗舰到27B轻量版、Flash效率模型及Flash-Next预览版已全部开放。

部分自媒体标题中的“抢先体验”“即将发布”表述与事实存在时间差，实际模型权重及API服务已稳定运行超过两个月。

#### 二、 开源矩阵与核心规格

本轮开源覆盖四个关键版本，形成完整的能力梯队：

模型版本 | 参数规模 | 开源协议 | 核心定位 | 硬件/成本门槛 
---|---|---|---|---
Qwen3.8-Max | 2.4T总参/95B激活 | Qwen3.8-Max License | 复杂编程、长周期Agent、企业级任务 | 需多节点集群；API输入2美元/百万Token 
Qwen3.8-27B | 27B稠密 | Apache 2.0 | 本地部署、私有知识库、数据不出域 | INT4量化约14-17GB，RTX 4090可跑 
Qwen3.8-Flash | 125B总参/6B激活 | Apache 2.0 | 高并发、客服、摘要、成本敏感场景 | 训练成本降90%；API输入1元/百万Token 
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 未公开 | Qwen Community License 1.0 | Qwen4架构预览、技术研究 | 商用需单独授权 

其中，Qwen3.8-27B在Hugging Face上超越DeepSeek-R1、Llama3.1等模型，成为该平台历史上最受欢迎的开源大模型；Qwen3.8-Max 0902版本在CodeArena前端编程总榜以1691分登顶，TerminalBench得分从11.3跃升至29.0。

#### 三、 “心理准备”的真实指向：许可证分化与商用边界

本轮开源最需警惕的变化是许可证不再统一为Apache 2.0，商用合规门槛实质性提高：

- Qwen3.8-27B：仍为Apache 2.0，个人及中小企业可免费商用、微调、私有化部署，无营收限制。
- Qwen3.8-Max：采用专用许可证。若经营MaaS或AI Work Assistant业务且连续12个月集团收入超5000万美元，商用前需另行授权；产品月活超1亿或月收入超2000万美元，还需在界面显著标注模型名称。
- Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：采用Qwen Community License 1.0，只要从事MaaS或AI Work Assistant业务即需单独授权，比Max许可证更严格。

对云厂商、模型聚合平台、AI编程助手等商业化团队而言，这些条款需法务介入评估；但对大多数个人开发者、研究团队和中小企业的内部使用，影响有限。

#### 四、 Qwen4状态核实：仍在训练，尚未发布

针对“最新版是否包含Qwen4”的疑问，2026年9月22日云栖大会明确披露：基于下一代架构的Qwen4已投入训练，但并未正式发布。会上展示的Qwen3.8-Flash-Next仅为Qwen4架构的技术预览版，不代表Qwen4正式版上线。后续Qwen4.5、Qwen5计划将参数规模扩展至5万亿至10万亿量级，但具体发布日期官方尚未公布。

#### 五、 尚未确认的信息与核验建议

- “抢先体验”专属入口：若您看到的“抢先体验”指向特定限时活动页面或专属兑换码，该信息未在官方公开渠道查到。建议直接访问aliyun.com/product/tongyi 或千问AI平台获取最新可用入口。
- Qwen4确切发布时间：截至目前无官方定论，建议关注通义实验室官方账号或阿里云百炼模型发布记录页获取第一时间通知。
- Max许可证合规细节：若您的业务涉及MaaS或AI助手且营收规模接近阈值，建议联系阿里通义团队获取正式授权文件，避免合规风险。

以上报道内容均基于2026年11月5日检索到的阿里云官方公告、云栖大会披露信息及开发者社区文章整理。模型版本、许可证条款及API定价可能随迭代更新，请以阿里云百炼平台及Hugging Face模型卡实时信息为准。

Qwen3.8-Flash是通义千问3.8系列主打高吞吐、高性价比的MoE模型，支持最高百万Token超长上下文窗口，兼顾推理速度与成本优势，适合RAG知识库、轻量智能体、批量文档处理、日常代码辅助等场景，也是本次2026阿里云双十一百炼平台主推的性价比款模型。和定位深度复杂推理的Qwen3.8-Max不同，Qwen3.8-Flash的原生单价更低，同时同步开放按量节省计划、Token Plan订阅抵扣、Night Plan夜间4折、上下文缓存折扣、新用户免费额度多重优惠，两套计费通道相互独立，优惠规则不能互通混用，很多开发者容易混淆两套体系的消耗倍率、折扣生效条件。本文围绕双十一活动周期、两套计费模式优惠细则、缓存优惠、夜间折扣叠加限制、场景选型、用量监控方法完整解析，搭配可直接运行的CLI查询命令，方便独立开发者、开发小组、中小企业评估调用成本，合理规划Qwen3.8-Flash的使用方案。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

本次Qwen3.8-Flash相关优惠周期和云上双十一大促保持一致，从预热阶段开启，持续至11月30日，所有折扣、节省计划新购、Token Plan订阅特惠、免费额度申领都需要在活动周期内操作。优惠入口集中在百炼Model Studio双十一会场，登录阿里云控制台，通过首页双十一banner跳转AI专场，即可找到Qwen3.8-Flash体验与优惠专区；新实名账号进入页面可以直接领取专属免费Token额度，先测试模型吞吐能力、评估Credits消耗速度，再选择按量付费或者Token Plan订阅方案，降低试错成本。该模型支持思考模式与普通问答模式，思考模式会产生额外推理Token，预估用量的时候需要把这部分消耗纳入预算。

### 2026年阿里云双十一活动入口：

Qwen3.8-Flash分为原生按量付费、Token Plan统一Credits订阅两套独立计费通道，双十一优惠分开执行，额度互不通用。

第一套：原生按量付费模式，适合调用量波动大、不想包月订阅的用户。Qwen3.8-Flash原生定价本身具备优势，输入每百万Token 0.8元，输出每百万Token 2.7元，同时自带上下文缓存折扣，缓存命中之后输入Token计费大幅降低，非常适合RAG、多轮对话这类重复加载上下文的业务场景。双十一期间上线AI通用节省计划，这份节省计划支持包含Qwen3.8-Flash在内的150多款百炼平台模型，包季档位最低至4.5折，购买之后自动抵扣按量调用账单，不需要额外配置，每次调用优先消耗节省计划额度，额度耗尽之后恢复原价计费。缓存折扣和节省计划可以叠加，进一步压低长文档、知识库场景的开销。

第二套：Token Plan订阅抵扣模式，也是本次双十一主推方案，包月统一Credits额度，Qwen3.8-Flash调用按照固定倍率扣减Credits，和按量付费体系相互独立。双十一Token Plan套餐本身有新客首购5折福利，Lite、Essential、Standard、Pro四档套餐都可以调用Qwen3.8-Flash，档位越高月度Credits额度越多，支持的Agent并发数量越高。其中Essential及以上套餐自带Harness工具权限，搭配Qwen3.8-Flash可以直接使用联网检索、代码解释器、文件解析等扩展能力，非常适合Hermes Agent、OpenClaw、轻量RAG项目开发。抵扣顺序为优先消耗当月套餐Credits，额度耗尽之后自动抵扣提前购买的补充用量包；套餐和用量包全部耗尽，调用直接暂停，不会自动切换按量付费产生意外账单；当月剩余Credits不会结转，订阅周期结束自动清零。

本次Qwen3.8-Flash一大亮点就是纳入Night Plan夜间限时4折优惠，北京时间每晚22:00至次日早上8:00期间调用该模型，Token Plan体系下Credits消耗直接打4折，仅消耗白天六成额度，和Qwen3.8-Max共享同一个夜间优惠时段。该权益不需要手动开通，订阅Token Plan之后到点自动生效，适合批量文档摘要、代码仓库扫描、知识库向量化整理、素材批量生成这类不需要实时响应的离线任务，把大批量任务调度到夜间执行，可以显著降低月度AI开销。需要重点区分：夜间4折只在Token Plan订阅体系内生效，原生按量付费通道调用Qwen3.8-Flash不享受夜间折扣，只能使用节省计划+缓存折扣来降本。

除折扣之外，新用户福利规则清晰：首次体验Qwen3.8-Flash的实名账号，可以领取免费体验额度，有效期90天，免费额度仅支持原生按量通道，不能在Token Plan订阅里面使用，额度用完之后自动转为正常计费。免费额度适合简单验证模型吞吐、调试Prompt、测试API连通性，不适合长期高频调用。

下面梳理优惠叠加的限制规则，也是高频踩坑点。首先，夜间4折仅作用于Token Plan的Credits消耗，按量节省计划和夜间折扣不能叠加；其次，Token Plan套餐折扣和按量节省计划相互独立，账单互不抵扣；代金券可以用于Token Plan订阅订单或者节省计划采购订单，单笔订单仅能使用一张满减券；套餐升配即时生效，差额按照订阅剩余天数折算扣费，降配要等到当前订阅周期结束之后才生效；Token Plan订阅订单不支持无理由退款，下单前一定要先用免费额度实测Qwen3.8-Flash的Credits消耗速度，避免档位选择过高造成额度浪费。另外，Qwen3.8-Flash虽然性价比高，但复杂数学推理、深度多步骤逻辑任务的效果弱于Qwen3.8-Max，选型的时候需要区分业务场景，不要盲目用Flash替代Max。

场景选型建议清晰易懂。独立开发者、偶尔调用、任务量不稳定，优先原生按量付费，搭配4.5折AI节省计划，随用随付，没有包月压力；搭建RAG知识库、轻量Agent、高频代码辅助，每天稳定调用，优先选购Token Plan套餐，搭配夜间4折调度批量任务，成本可控；小团队内部业务、批量数据处理，优先Token Plan团队版席位，支持成员权限隔离、独立API Key分配、用量看板统计；短期Demo验证、方案测试，直接使用新用户免费额度，不需要付费；高并发在线问答、客服对话，结合缓存折扣，优先按量模式搭配节省计划。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

开发者可以使用阿里云CLI命令，查询订阅信息、Qwen3.8-Flash调用用量、API Key、优惠券，用来做自动化监控、账单预估，下面命令可以直接复制执行。
查看账号内百炼订阅、Token Plan套餐信息：
aliyun bailian ListSubscriptions --Output json

          AI 代码解读

查询指定周期Qwen3.8-Flash的调用消耗明细，评估Credits消耗速度：
aliyun bailian ListUsageRecords --StartTime "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z" --EndTime "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z" --ModelId qwen3.8-flash --Output json

          AI 代码解读

查询账号可用代金券，确认是否可以用于订阅或者节省计划采购：
aliyun bssopenapi QueryCouponList --Output json

          AI 代码解读

获取百炼平台API Key，用于本地Agent、代码项目接入Qwen3.8-Flash：
aliyun bailian GetApiKey --Output json

          AI 代码解读

最后总结几个实操避坑要点。第一，两套计费通道相互隔离，按量节省计划和Token Plan额度互不通用；第二，夜间4折仅限Token Plan体系，按量调用没有该权益；第三，开启思考模式之后Token消耗明显上涨，批量任务预估额度时必须预留余量；第四，上下文缓存折扣仅在按量通道生效，Token Plan内缓存命中只会间接减少Credits消耗，没有单独标注缓存折扣；第五，Qwen3.8-Flash主打性价比吞吐，复杂深度推理任务建议切换Qwen3.8-Max；第六，补充用量包不能单独购买，必须绑定一份有效Token Plan主套餐。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

Qwen3.8-Flash分为原生按量付费、Token Plan统一Credits订阅两套独立计费通道，双十一优惠分开执行，额度互不通用。

第一套：原生按量付费模式，适合调用量波动大、不想包月订阅的用户。Qwen3.8-Flash原生定价本身具备优势，输入每百万Token 0.8元，输出每百万Token 2.7元，同时自带上下文缓存折扣，缓存命中之后输入Token计费大幅降低，非常适合RAG、多轮对话这类重复加载上下文的业务场景。双十一期间上线AI通用节省计划，这份节省计划支持包含Qwen3.8-Flash在内的150多款百炼平台模型，包季档位最低至4.5折，购买之后自动抵扣按量调用账单，不需要额外配置，每次调用优先消耗节省计划额度，额度耗尽之后恢复原价计费。缓存折扣和节省计划可以叠加，进一步压低长文档、知识库场景的开销。

第二套：Token Plan订阅抵扣模式，也是本次双十一主推方案，包月统一Credits额度，Qwen3.8-Flash调用按照固定倍率扣减Credits，和按量付费体系相互独立。双十一Token Plan套餐本身有新客首购5折福利，Lite、Essential、Standard、Pro四档套餐都可以调用Qwen3.8-Flash，档位越高月度Credits额度越多，支持的Agent并发数量越高。其中Essential及以上套餐自带Harness工具权限，搭配Qwen3.8-Flash可以直接使用联网检索、代码解释器、文件解析等扩展能力，非常适合Hermes Agent、OpenClaw、轻量RAG项目开发。抵扣顺序为优先消耗当月套餐Credits，额度耗尽之后自动抵扣提前购买的补充用量包；套餐和用量包全部耗尽，调用直接暂停，不会自动切换按量付费产生意外账单；当月剩余Credits不会结转，订阅周期结束自动清零。

本次Qwen3.8-Flash一大亮点就是纳入Night Plan夜间限时4折优惠，北京时间每晚22:00至次日早上8:00期间调用该模型，Token Plan体系下Credits消耗直接打4折，仅消耗白天六成额度，和Qwen3.8-Max共享同一个夜间优惠时段。该权益不需要手动开通，订阅Token Plan之后到点自动生效，适合批量文档摘要、代码仓库扫描、知识库向量化整理、素材批量生成这类不需要实时响应的离线任务，把大批量任务调度到夜间执行，可以显著降低月度AI开销。需要重点区分：夜间4折只在Token Plan订阅体系内生效，原生按量付费通道调用Qwen3.8-Flash不享受夜间折扣，只能使用节省计划+缓存折扣来降本。

除折扣之外，新用户福利规则清晰：首次体验Qwen3.8-Flash的实名账号，可以领取免费体验额度，有效期90天，免费额度仅支持原生按量通道，不能在Token Plan订阅里面使用，额度用完之后自动转为正常计费。免费额度适合简单验证模型吞吐、调试Prompt、测试API连通性，不适合长期高频调用。

下面梳理优惠叠加的限制规则，也是高频踩坑点。首先，夜间4折仅作用于Token Plan的Credits消耗，按量节省计划和夜间折扣不能叠加；其次，Token Plan套餐折扣和按量节省计划相互独立，账单互不抵扣；代金券可以用于Token Plan订阅订单或者节省计划采购订单，单笔订单仅能使用一张满减券；套餐升配即时生效，差额按照订阅剩余天数折算扣费，降配要等到当前订阅周期结束之后才生效；Token Plan订阅订单不支持无理由退款，下单前一定要先用免费额度实测Qwen3.8-Flash的Credits消耗速度，避免档位选择过高造成额度浪费。另外，Qwen3.8-Flash虽然性价比高，但复杂数学推理、深度多步骤逻辑任务的效果弱于Qwen3.8-Max，选型的时候需要区分业务场景，不要盲目用Flash替代Max。

### 【AI速览】2026 年国产大模型旗舰全维度对比：商汤日日新、DeepSeek等价格完整对比

## 【AI 速览】2026 年国产大模型旗舰全维度横评：商汤日日新、DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阿里云通义千问，价格、性能、定位、落地场景完整对比

2026 年 11 月 · 数据截至 2026 年 11 月，依据各厂商公开 API 定价、公开基准成绩与产品资料整理

2026 年国产大模型已经全面进入百万上下文、原生 Agent、工程级代码、阶梯低价并行的阶段，几家闭源旗舰的路线差异越来越清楚：DeepSeek 主打极致性价比的代码推理，智谱 GLM 专注工程开发与长代码库，Kimi 走超长文档与多任务拆解，商汤日日新把原生多模态和办公长链路交付做成一件事，阿里云通义千问依托百炼做企业全栈配套。

本文按最新版本、价格体系、核心性能、侧重点、短板、开发适配、日常使用体验七个维度横向拆解五家，文末分三类人群给出落地建议。文中条目按品牌归类排列，顺序仅为阅读顺序，不构成官方排名。

### 2.2 价格分层总结

按 " 交付物 " 算成本：商汤日日新 6.7 Flash-Lite 用原生多模态架构替代 " 先图像转文字、再喂给语言模型 " 的两段式流程，官方口径下信息搜索类场景的 Token 消耗比纯文本智能体省约 60%；一份报告、一套 PPT 这类长链路任务，钱主要花在 " 出成品 " 上，而不是花在中间层反复搬运素材。

极致低 token 单价：DeepSeek V4-Pro，输出仅 6 元 / 百万 Token，同等代码推理成本约为智谱的 1/5。

云原生企业批量集成：阿里云 Qwen3.7 Max，新用户免费额度充足，Batch 批量调用半价。

纯网页日常办公阅读：Kimi 网页会员 30 元包月不限量，API 商用成本偏高。

重度工程团队、代码重构：智谱 GLM-5.2，单价最贵，但长代码库推理稳定性独一档。

原生多模态，不是 " 语言模型外挂一个视觉模型 "：视觉能力长在模型底座里，端到端读文档、看表格、解析图片，取消 " 先转成文字再理解 " 的中间层；256K 上下文（输入 252K、输出 64K），FP8 量化部署，支持并行工具调用（parallel_tool_calls），一次响应里可以同时发起多个工具请求。

端到端长链路，交付的是成品不是建议：跑通 " 读资料 — 整信息 — 做判断 — 产交付物 " 全流程。配套开源的 Cowork-Skill 体系把能力拆成 8 项可组合组件 —— 理解层（材料分析、多源检索整合、表格理解与图像分析）、执行层（数据分析结论、PPT 对话精修）、生成层（PPT 生成、报告撰写输出、Infographic 生成），既能单点调用，也能串成一条完整工作流。

视觉化交付单独有一套：SenseNova U1 Fast 走独立的图像生成接口，输出 2K 分辨率信息图，内置 87 种布局模板与 66 种风格，秒级出图，专门解决 " 内容都对、排版难看 " 的最后一公里。

接入路径四条并存：网页端直接调用、OpenAI 兼容 API（token.sensenova.cn/v1，改 base_url 即可迁移）、企业级定制能力组合、私有化本地部署，数据不出机房。

公开基准上有据可查：SenseNova 6.7 Flash-Lite 在 PinchBench、ClawEval、Deep Planning 等基准中成绩领先同体量模型，长链路任务规划、多模态理解是主要长处；

落地案例具体：10 份月度 Excel 自动整合成完整员工绩效分析报告、一次产出 11 章节投行级产业研究报告、自动生成 8 页独立版式的科技展览级 PPT；

## 五、分人群落地推荐（直接对照自身选择）

### 人群一：专业程序员 / 全职后端开发者（高频写代码、重构项目、做 API 集成）

### 日常轻量开发、批量脚本、低成本接口调用

首选 DeepSeek V4-Pro。代码推理质量第一梯队，API 价格极低，循环批量生成 CRUD、SQL、运维脚本、单元测试成本可控，支持开源本地部署，国内云平台均可接入。

### 大型 Monorepo、千万行遗留系统重构、团队工程开发

首选 智谱 GLM-5.2 Ultra。100 万无损上下文，改代码自动同步全项目依赖，代码幻觉低，配套 IDE 插件无缝开发，企业数据隔离满足线上合规。

### 云原生阿里云体系内项目、企业私有化部署

首选 阿里云 Qwen3.7 Max。和阿里云 ECS / 数据库 / 存储无缝打通，权限、监控、分账一体化，支持批量半价调用，新用户百万免费额度试错。

### 人群二：轻度使用者（日常办公、看资料、写文案、学生、产品，几乎不写代码）

### 读 PDF、标书、合同、整理资料、写方案、竞品调研

首选 Kimi 网页端（30 元包月无限使用）。拖拽上传百份文件，自动拆解梳理，多步骤头脑风暴，零门槛操作，无需理解 Token 计费。

### 做汇报 PPT、出信息图、把一堆 Excel 变成分析报告（职场 / 研究岗）

首选 商汤日日新 6.7 Flash-Lite + U1 Fast。丢一份月度数据或一堆资料进去，出来的是排好版的报告或 PPT，不用在 " 整理数据 " 和 " 排版 " 两个工具之间来回倒；U1 Fast 出 2K 信息图，内置 87 种布局模板，配图不用再找设计。要留意的是，短视频脚本、口播配音这类内容生产仍要看专门的工具，它不是全能选手。

### 纯免费试用、短期写文档、临时查资料，不想充值

首选 阿里云百炼 Qwen3.7 Max。新用户开通直接赠送数百万免费 Token，网页工具可临时处理文档、简单绘图、写代码，试用期无成本。

### 人群三：独立副业 / 出海开发者（兼顾调研、素材、代码、低成本上线 APP）

### 组合搭配（兼顾成本与全场景）

### 单模型只选一款

推荐 商汤日日新 6.7 Flash-Lite。一套工具覆盖调研、数据分析、报告、PPT、信息图，公测期不按量计费，副业真正稀缺的是时间而不是每百万 Token 差两块钱；如果副业重心在写代码，再补一个 DeepSeek 的 API 就够用。

## 六、生产落地避坑总结

口径与注意事项：①五家的版本、价格、上下文规格均取各厂商官网公开信息，价格为刊发时点数值，签约前请复查；②" 星级 "" 成本分层 " 是本文基于公开资料的相对标注，不构成官方评分，也不构成购买建议；③上下文长度、Token 计费方式各家定义不同（有的按原生上限公示，有的靠付费解锁），跨家比较时先对齐口径；④单项分数与榜单名次随版本迭代波动，参考时宜结合具体业务场景验证，不建议用单一指标做选型决策。

# 千问 - 阿里AI助手

问答 工作 任务 PPT 翻译 写作 生图生视频 拍题

免费 · App 内购买

千问APP是体验最新、最强千问大模型的第一入口，“回答聪明，帮你办事”，旨在成为你在工作、学习、生活中的AI助手。 【对话问答】 超强大模型，回答更聪明； 拥有优质知识源，更擅长专业领域问答； 答案结构化呈现，主动推荐图表、视频辅助理解。 思考研究全新升级，面向复杂专业问题，提供研究级的深度回答。 【工作助理】 全新上线工作助理，支持复杂任务交付，从回答问题升级为完成任务； 可直接交付网页/应用/PPT/Word/Excel/图片等格式的成品文件，打开即用； 依托专业数据，严选skills技能，人机协作交付结果更可靠。 【定时任务】 全新上线定时任务能力，到点自动触发执行并交付结果； 支持周期性和一次性两种定时任务类型，生活琐事、关键信息收集、工作提效，件件不遗漏。 【语音通话】 7×24 小时在线陪伴，支持互动陪玩、睡前故事、带娃讲题、语音打车等多场景通话。 【AI智能体】 智能体广场全新上线，多家官方品牌智能体已入驻，提供官方信息和专业服务； 对话中 @一下即可直接唤起智能体。 【AI生活帮手】 帮你搞定生活大小事，支持点外卖/订酒店/找餐厅/办政务，同时也可以为你提供购物建议。 【智能生产力】 AI写作：全体裁写作，智能排版； AI PPT：支持文件/图片/问答内容一键生成PPT，海量PPT模版自由选择，支持PPT导出成多格式； 智能编辑器：可在对话中直接编辑、修改生成内容，并保存下载输出，支持PDF/WORD/PPT/EXCEL多格式互转； 文档阅读：支持一次上传10个文档/图片，500页超长文也可以轻松处理，支持快速总结资料、数据分析、翻译等任务。论文、财报、报告解读等内容处理，尽管交给千问； 代码处理：支持一句话生成代码，用于设计小程序/网页/小游戏/sql撰写等；也可以上传代码或代码截图，让千问帮你检查与改写； 实时记录：支持离线或实时语音转文字，适用于会议纪要、音视频解读，还能智能生成会议总结与代办事项等。 【AI创作】 Wan 3.0视频生成模型全网首发公测，在一致性、真实感、叙事上均有商用级别的表现，并且支持单段30秒视频生成。 【学习辅导】 小讲堂：AI老师可视化板书讲解，实时语音答疑辅导，从讲题目、课本到古诗、成语，给你更生动鲜活的AI课堂； 拍题答疑：全学段全学科都能解，解题更准确，回答更聪明； 作业批改：支持诊断作业、分析薄弱点、定制专属练习，学得更精准； 资料查找：涵盖学习资料、试卷模板、行业报告等5亿资料库。 【自动续费规则】 1.用户协议 https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/c_end_product_protocol/20231011201348415/20231011201348415.html 2.隐私条款 https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/privacy_policy_full/20231011201849846/20231011201849846.html 3.会员协议 https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/c_end_product_protocol/20260728154300619/20260728154300619.html 4.订阅会员服务会通过AppStore账户直接支付 5.在订阅服务到期前24小时，系统将按订购类型进行自动续订和扣除相应费用 6.如需关闭连续包月服务，请至少提前24小时在“账户设置”中进行操作 查看应用程序用户许可协议： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

## 活动

- Eliyas伊伊
必须给千问APP打满五星好评，这软件真的是我日常点外卖的省钱宝藏，用过之后再也不想换别的平台了！很早之前我就下载过千问，那段时间经常用它点外卖，前后算下来差不多有二十单，当时平台有一分钱点外卖的超值活动，性价比直接拉满，饭菜分量足、配送也准时，体验感特别好，后来因为换手机暂时卸载了，心里一直惦记着这个省钱工具。最近重新下载回来，发现优惠力度一点没缩水，甚至更划算！现在每天点外卖都能固定减3.8元，对比过其他主流外卖软件，同样的商家、同样的餐品，用千问下单总价永远更低，长期点外卖能省下不少零花钱，对于天天需要点外卖的打工人来说，这笔优惠真的太实在了。不光外卖优惠给力，千问本身的AI功能也特别全面，宣传里说的高考志愿填报、写文案、做PPT、解题画图全都能搞定，平时工作写总结、做简单演示文稿，生活里查各类问题、出门订餐购物，一个软件就能覆盖超多需求，不用来回切换多个APP，实用性拉满。软件操作界面简洁干净，没有乱七八糟的弹窗广告，外卖下单流程简单清晰，选餐、领券、付款一步到位，优惠券领取没有复杂门槛，每天都能轻松领到减免券，配送速度和商家品质和其他平台完全持平，不会因为优惠大就降低服务标准。既能靠AI解决学习工作各类难题，又能长期稳定领取外卖大额减免，一分钱低价餐、每日立减3.8元的福利真实靠谱，双重优势很难找到替代品。真心安利给所有经常点外卖、平时需要AI辅助处理事务的朋友，下载绝对不亏，会一直长期使用！

- tr r r r r
当初是依据千问 APP 的思维导图功能才下载软件，结果 APP 思维导图功能在对于知识整合方面并没有任何用处，仅仅是做到把课题标出来，甚至在已经提供清晰内容后，仍然无法对内容进行总结，我最初是因为千问APP宣传的思维导图知识整合功能，专门下载安装该软件，核心使用需求为整理高中知识点、完成系统化知识归纳。但实际使用后，该核心功能完全达不到基础使用标准，存在多处严重缺陷：思维导图完全不具备知识整合、总结提炼能力，即便我提前输入逻辑完整、条理清晰的成套学习内容，千问导图仅能机械罗列课题小标题，无法对文本内容归纳、精简、提炼核心要点，完全起不到思维导图梳理知识体系的作用，仅空有导图外壳，无实际学习价值，生成导图存在重复造假问题，软件多次生成内容完全一致的思维导图，仅简单更换分支颜色，核心文字、层级、内容完全照搬复刻，属于无效重复生成，浪费使用额度与用户时间，用户指出导图出错后，模型应对逻辑混乱、答非所问，当我明确告知生成的思维导图存在错误、层级混乱、归类不合理时，千问并未修正导图，而是完全偏离问题、胡乱作答，将原有导图内容以纯文本形式重复复述一遍，完全无视我的纠错诉求，无法完成修正优化，客服致歉流于表面，没有实质解决方案，在反馈上述功能故障与回答错误问题后，平台仅给出模板化、浮于表面的客套道歉，没有解释功能缺陷原因、没有给出优化方案、没有对应补偿措施，完全无法解决用户核心痛点，辜负了用户因核心功能下载软件的信任，整体来看，该APP主推的思维导图功能名不副实，存在严重功能夸大、实际能力不足问题，且故障反馈后的应答机制、售后反馈机制不完善，严重影响正常学习使用。
